Ripple joins UBS and SIX as one of Tenity’s global strategic partners, continuing their successful collaboration on accelerator
Ripple joins UBS and SIX as one of Tenity’s global strategic partners, continuing their successful collaboration on accelerator programs for XRP Ledger startups since 2023.

Tenity, the global innovation ecosystem and early-stage investor creating the future of finance, is deepening its focus on decentralized finance (DeFi) through its Incubation Fund II, supporting new innovative projects building blockchain-based solutions on the XRP Ledger (XRPL) welcoming Ripple as its new global strategic partner and Limited Partner in the Tenity Inc.

Backed by investments from UBS, SIX Group, Julius Baer, Generali’s House of InsurTech Switzerland, and now Ripple as a strategic partner, Tenity is empowering startups to create impactful solutions in blockchain and financial technology.
The XRP Ledger (XRPL) is a decentralized, energy-efficient blockchain with native capabilities including a decentralized exchange (DEX), tokenization support, escrow, and more.

With over a decade of proven reliability, scalability, and zero security breaches, the XRPL has powered financial use cases including global payments, digital asset custody, real-world asset tokenization, and institutional DeFi.
“We believe decentralized finance is reshaping the future of financial services by offering more accessible, efficient, and innovative solutions,” said Andreas Iten, CEO and Co-Founder at Tenity .

“By empowering startups to drive this transformation, we aim to accelerate the development of technologies that can solve real-world challenges and redefine the way financial systems operate globally.” Since April 2023, Tenity has led accelerator programs alongside its partner Ripple, specifically targeting startups building scalable solutions on the XRP Ledger.

These efforts have supported 29 startups globally, with over 200 applications received, helping early-stage companies develop groundbreaking use cases in DeFi, real-world asset (RWA) tokenization, and payments.

Ripple’s commitment to fostering financial innovation through support for early-stage startups and collaboration with emerging fintech ecosystems is closely aligned with Tenity’s dedication to innovation and growth.
The Tenity Inc Fund II invests in the broader fintech & insurtech space at pre-seed and seed stage through its accelerator programs in Zurich, Singapore, and Tallinn.
Tenity is building a large portfolio with broad market coverage, covering all subsegments of fintech and insurtech.
It poses a unique opportunity for investors to participate in early-stage innovations with high potential impact for the financial industry.

Singapore – Aug 04, 2025 – Seven ambitious startups have officially graduated from the ninth edition of the Tenity Fin/Tech Accelerator Program in Singapore.

From AI-powered financial operations to embedded finance and document security, this cohort brings forward innovative solutions that span across customer service, healthcare, sales, F&B, and impact finance.

The four-month accelerator program, which concluded on June 5, was designed to help early-stage fintech startups refine their products, strengthen their business fundamentals, and prepare for fundraising.

Founders received hands-on mentorship from Tenity’s local team, participated in masterclasses and fireside chats with seasoned entrepreneurs and experts, and followed a tailored curriculum covering product-market fit, branding, go-to-market strategies, pitch practice, and more.

The journey culminated in a Demo Day, where founders pitched their companies to an invite-only audience of investors, corporate innovation leaders, and ecosystem partners—marking a key milestone toward becoming investor-ready.
Earlybird AI | Singapore Earlybird AI builds autonomous financial operations agents that work around the clock.
Their AI-native solution handles everything from payments to ledger management, reports, and tax preparation—giving modern businesses more time and savings.
GoBarakah | Malaysia GoBarakah is a purpose-driven fintech that transforms donation funds into secure, traceable e-vouchers.
Momofin | Indonesia Momofin uses cryptographic hashes and forensic technology to secure documents, protecting them from tampering and fraud.
PaperlessHospital | Indonesia PaperlessHospital is an AI-powered medical scribe that automates clinical documentation in real time.
The platform reduces administrative workload for healthcare professionals, enabling them to focus more on patient care and less on paperwork.
